vBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2194: Mechanically prevent the Flywheel orchestrator from authoring/committing artifacts (harness-agnostic git guard)

plan.title: Flywheel orchestrator did inline work — add mechanical, harness-agnostic write/commit guard
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: The flywheel orchestrator (RUN-45 on codex/gpt-5.5) edited a PRD, authored a 437-line vBRIEF, and committed+pushed both to main (862eebfc9c), bypassing the pipeline. The role prompt was hardened, but the prompt is the only lever: the pre-push guard (guard-agent-main-push.sh:51) only refuses code paths so a .pan/ vBRIEF slips through, and there is no commit-time guard at all; on claude-code the auto-approve-hook auto-approves every flywheel-* tool. An orchestrator must only dispatch, never author artifacts.
narratives.Proposal: Add a harness-agnostic mechanical guard keyed on OVERDECK_AGENT_ID=flywheel-orchestrator (which reaches even the codex shell env). (1) A new .husky/pre-commit guard refuses any staged path outside a shared allowlist (docs/FLYWHEEL-STATE.md + state dirs .pan/records/,.pan/continues/,.pan/backlog/,.beads/) — load-bearing, works on codex/claude-code/pi. (2) Broaden the pre-push guard to cover orchestrator artifact paths (backstop). (3) Extend the claude-code auto-approve-hook to DENY Write/Edit to non-allowlisted repo paths for flywheel-* (defense-in-depth). (4) Document that the ban is now mechanical. No harness/model change, no codex sandbox restriction.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Restricting or changing the orchestrator harness/model, or adding a codex read-only sandbox
- Fixing `pan flywheel stop` reporting success without killing the session (file separately)
- The codex sandbox /api limitation / sandbox-safe CLI surfaces (sibling issue)
- Defending against a deliberate `git commit --no-verify` bypass (branch protection / CI is the backstop)
- Blocking working-tree edits on codex (no PreToolUse there); the commit guard prevents the durable artifact

autoDecisions.summary: Chose a harness-agnostic git-level mechanical guard over a harness/model restriction.
autoDecisions.rationale: OVERDECK_AGENT_ID=flywheel-orchestrator reaches the codex shell env (codex.ts:567), so a git hook blocks the incident on any harness. This respects 'let Cloister route models', 'never force --harness claude-code for CLIProxy models', and 'never hardcode a model fallback' — a harness force would violate all three.

autoDecisions.summary: Allowlist = docs/FLYWHEEL-STATE.md + state dirs (.pan/records/,.pan/continues/,.pan/backlog/,.beads/); everything else refused.
autoDecisions.rationale: The orchestrator legitimately commits only FLYWHEEL-STATE.md. State dirs are a safe superset (pipeline state, never authored content) that avoids false-positives on legitimate in-process state commits. Incident paths (.pan/drafts/**, .pan/specs/**, code) stay blocked.

autoDecisions.summary: Did not add a codex read-only sandbox.
autoDecisions.rationale: read-only would block the legitimate FLYWHEEL-STATE.md write and could break pan-dispatch writes under ~/.overdeck.

autoDecisions.summary: Commit/push policing lives in git hooks; the claude-code hook only polices Write/Edit.
autoDecisions.rationale: Git hooks inspect staged paths precisely and are harness-agnostic; a Bash 'git commit' string is hard to inspect in a PreToolUse hook, and denying all git commit would break the FLYWHEEL-STATE.md tick commit.

narrative.Action: Create scripts/guard-flywheel-orchestrator-commit.sh: if OVERDECK_AGENT_ID != flywheel-orchestrator exit 0; else read `git diff --cached --name-only` and refuse (exit 1, naming offending paths) any staged path not equal to docs/FLYWHEEL-STATE.md and not under .pan/records/,.pan/continues/,.pan/backlog/,.beads/. Wire it into .husky/pre-commit (currently empty) as `bash scripts/guard-flywheel-orchestrator-commit.sh </dev/null`. Add a vitest test mirroring tests/unit/scripts/guard-agent-main-push.test.ts (execFileSync bash against a temp git repo).

narrative.Action: Extend sync-sources/hooks/auto-approve-hook: for OVERDECK_AGENT_ID matching flywheel-* and TOOL_NAME in {Write,Edit,MultiEdit}, extract tool_input.file_path (jq), resolve against repo root; if it is inside the repo and NOT in the write-allowlist (docs/FLYWHEEL-STATE.md or under .pan/records/,.pan/continues/,.pan/backlog/,.beads/) emit permissionDecision:"deny" and exit 0. Writes outside the repo and to FLYWHEEL-STATE.md fall through to the existing allow. Leave all non-flywheel branches unchanged. Extend the existing test file. Note: deploying requires `pan sync`.
